reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Assistant authentication and initial HTTP routes
reason: Assistant stream journal correctness (commit/reopen, contention, idempotency, replay bounds, process exit, ownership, cancellation) and fair scheduling (project/parent fairness, session FIFO, waits, bounded admission and cleanup). Python selection covers the assistant contract projection and exact-test receipt/runner policy, including existing guard regressions. Three CLI cases verify new fixture/replay behavior, truthful journal-only measurements, bounded inputs and no Core server mode. Canonical persisted-record port: six exact Rust tests compare 147 Python-oracle cases across 13 kinds, retention/retraction, missing identity fields, errors without payload disclosure, byte bounds and concurrent readers. Python contract tests regenerate the oracle against current schemas. The locked JSON representation now preserves arbitrary precision integers; existing focused journal/scheduler/CLI selections remain in CI to cover the cumulative PR. Existing-schema SQLite persistence: nine exact storage tests cover thirteen kinds, transactional projections, revision conflicts, WAL reader isolation, indexed paging, byte limits, cancellation, process exit, schema refusal and patch amplification. A seventh domain test compares legacy defaults with Python. Python tests regenerate the isolated storage fixture and perform an actual Python to Rust to Python to Rust handoff. Rust compile/collection: 600 seconds per command; each selected Rust test: 120 seconds. Interop build: 600 seconds; each child: 120 seconds. Seven exact Assistant service tests cover the 27-step Python saved-context/cursor oracle, promotion rollback and history, competing edits, transaction preconditions, Unicode/context limits, paired-device ownership and a queued source-change race. The services package is separately allowlisted for exact test selection. Its oracle is regenerated by a focused Python contract test. No production HTTP route is activated. Eight exact authentication/HTTP checks cover the paired-device contract, 33 captured Python authentication cases (complete normalized bodies/status/challenge headers), lookup beyond 1000 devices, concurrent activity refresh and revocation, saved-context/read-cursor durability through HTTP, body/request/response bounds and deadlines, corrupt-record privacy, and an isolated loopback TCP listener. Existing nine entity-store regressions cover the writer-lane extension; the focused Python contract test regenerates the authentication oracle against actual API middleware. Local selection is these 17 Rust tests and the 24 Python contract/selection checks; CI retains the cumulative 55 exact Rust / 45 Python selection. No full suites.
exclusions: No shipped listener or launch path is switched. Experimental Rust transport implements three Assistant routes only; full request-coercion and service-error parity, remaining routes, CORS, SSE/WebSocket, catch-up projections, workflow deletion, dispatch, provider/harness integration, historical migrations, PostgreSQL, mission checkpoints, production UI/mobile/LAN/device and performance gates remain incomplete. No live data/service, provider calls, real tools or full suites. Figma inspection is design review, not prototype clickthrough or production evidence. Other product areas and desktop-native workspace remain unchanged.
